caption: The drawing depicts a scene with a total of eight human figures in front of a large wooden cross positioned centrally in the composition. At the top of the cross is an inscription reading "INRI." At the upper left, a figure in a long, light-colored garment is nailing onto the cross, with one knee resting on a ladder that leans against the cross. Flanking this central cross on both sides are three figures each, positioned vertically and facing inward; four of these figures wear elaborate headpieces colored in red and white, resembling bishop's miters. Among the six, two figures, one on each side, wear long green cloak-like garments and have long white beards. In the foreground, directly in front of the cross, are three main figures: the central seated figure wears a red dress and blue head covering, supporting another figure who is reclining and draped over her lap, wearing a reddish-brown and white-striped garment, with marks suggesting wounds on the arms and legs. To the right, a standing figure in a pale pink robe and head covering clasps hands to the chest. The color palette of the drawing is dominated by earthy tones, especially browns, greens, reds, whites, and muted pinks. The background contains a brown sky with gray clouds and green vegetation at the lower section. The entire scene is bordered at the top and bottom by off-white margins.
title: Station of the Cross No. 13: "Jesus is Taken Down from the Cross"
